evidence.excerpt: Fresh live inspection of the 14th & T storefront inventoried every visible current food, nonalcoholic drink, and edible retail product, including current seasonal products and 14th-only frozen retail items; alcohol and merchandise were excluded.

Fresh live inspection of the Wharf storefront inventoried every visible current food, nonalcoholic drink, and edible retail product, including Wharf-only large plates and kids products; alcohol and merchandise were excluded.

Current two-page Café PDF, freshly rendered and visually reviewed in full. It provides the complete shared Café-class food and nonalcoholic catalog, direct ingredient descriptions, dietary symbols, and a gluten-friendly cross-contamination qualifier.
Current two-page Cafecito PDF, freshly rendered and visually reviewed in full. It provides the complete shared 14th St/Mosaic food and nonalcoholic catalog and the same gluten-friendly qualifier.

Current ten-page catering PDF, freshly rendered and visually reviewed in full. It publishes breakfast, sandwich, salad, buffet, platter, dessert, and nonalcoholic beverage presentations plus vegetarian, vegan, gluten-friendly, and contains-nuts legend terms.
Current two-page happy-hour PDF, freshly rendered and visually reviewed in full. Only food and zero-proof products were inventoried; alcoholic cocktails, beer, and wine were excluded.
Current official homepage identifies Colada Shop as a DC/Northern Virginia café group and advertises current seasonal food, coffee, zero-proof drinks, dietary options, and ordering.

Current official menu hub scopes the Café menu to Wharf, Dupont Circle, Clarendon, and National Landing; the smaller Cafecito menu to 14th St and Mosaic District; happy hour to the four Café stores; and links the current catering menu. Menus may vary seasonally or by location.
The official-linked live Toast directory confirms six orderable storefronts: 14th & T, Clarendon, Dupont, Mosaic, National Landing, and Wharf, with exact addresses and store-specific ordering links.
Official locations page identifies the Washington DC and Northern Virginia location set. Product scope is limited to the six storefronts assigned a public menu class; DCA is not assigned one.
